description: A shell script for testing cherry-picking behavior with empty commits in Git, including setup, various cherry-pick scenarios, and validation checks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks that output contains a specific string.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or state.

methods.name: test_commit_message
methods.description: Verifies the commit message of the current HEAD.
